seoTitle: Infrastructure & Quality — Machines and Quality Checks | JURO, Ghaziabad
seoDescription: JURO's works in Rajinder Nagar Industrial Area, Ghaziabad: Traub automats, power presses, drilling, milling, grinding, welding and gas cutting machines, with every lot checked before dispatch.
heading: Infrastructure & Quality
intro: Turning, pressing, machining and fabrication under one roof at our works in Rajinder Nagar Industrial Area, Ghaziabad.
capabilitiesHeading: What our shop floor can do

capabilities.title: Precision turning
capabilities.text: Traub automatic lathes and a lathe machine for turned components such as rivets, studs, bushes, pins and spacers.

capabilities.title: Press shop
capabilities.text: Power presses of 20, 10 and 5 ton capacity, running press tools for blanking, piercing and forming sheet metal parts.

capabilities.title: Drilling, tapping & milling
capabilities.text: Drilling machines, a tapping machine and a vertical milling machine for secondary operations.

capabilities.title: Grinding & finishing
capabilities.text: A surface grinder for flatness and surface finish on machined parts.

capabilities.title: Welding & fabrication
capabilities.text: MIG and arc welding, gas cutting and a band saw for industrial fabrication and job work.

capabilities.title: Power backup
capabilities.text: A 15 kVA generator set keeps production running during power cuts.

machinesText: Our works at Rajinder Nagar Industrial Area is equipped for turning, drilling, tapping, milling, grinding, pressing, welding and cutting, with 23 machines in total including power backup.
qualityText: After manufacturing, our range is checked by quality controllers on defined parameters such as durability, performance, raw material used and reliability, so that only sound components reach our customers.
rawMaterialText: Raw material is sourced from established vendors, and components can be customised to the technical specifications shared by customers.
